##### Intervention regime

We imagine that in certain types of studies, the investigator is able to “intervene” on an NPSEM by setting the value of a random variable through experiment (a randomized control trial, for instance). In *static interventions* the value is set to a constant whereas in *dynamic interventions* the investigator changes the form of the structural equation that usually produces that random variable. An intervention regime is a collection of interventions.
